verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a public REST API (Transactions, OAuth 2.0 authorization, webhooks) with a machine-readable llms.txt index, plus a CLI and MCP server explicitly built for driving Ramp actions programmatically or via AI agents. This covers documented public API access comprehensively across auth, data retrieval, and actions. Missing for 10: independent third-party developer reports/hands-on confirmation of API robustness beyond Ramp's own docs.
